catalysts.headline: Affirm announced it will report Q1 FY2027 results on November 5, 2026
Stock hit a 52-week high of $90.44 the session after the Q4 earnings beat

Q4 FY2026: revenue ~$1.17B (+33% YoY, beat consensus by 5.4%); net income ~$1.62B / diluted EPS $4.62 (vs $0.33 consensus), driven by a $1.45B income-tax valuation-allowance release; GMV $14.1B (+36% YoY); guided Sept-quarter revenue to $1.19B-$1.22B and GMV to $13.7B-$14.0B. Full FY2026: revenue $4.26B, net income $1.93B / diluted EPS $5.53
catalysts.impact: headline beat, though a quality-of-earnings caveat applies due to the tax item; stock rose toward a 52-week high the next session
